description: Kisetsu v1.3.0 — horizontal grab handle, white settings icons, tapered home card transitions, smaller tactile player and SF Pro Display font.

changelog.title: Player
items: Horizontal low-opacity grab handle above the small Playing from caption
Player controls slightly smaller with light haptics on play, skip and like
Lyrics side margins keep every letter fully visible

changelog.title: Home & settings
items: Tapered gradient blend between home card artwork and caption text
All settings icons now white with no coloured tile background

changelog.title: Typography
items: Bundled SF-Pro-Display-Bold and made it the app's bold face and lyrics font
